verdict.rationale: The only first-party evidence is a homepage mention of 'bring your own cloud with PlanetScale Managed' (planetscale-docs-47). That deploys into the customer's own cloud account but is still a vendor-managed offering, not a self-hosted install. A community user's hands-on read (planetscale-comm-13) concluded the product cannot be installed locally, run offline, or obtained as fully open source. Missing for 10: a documented self-hostable distribution of the core product, install/operations docs for running it yourself, offline or local deployment, details on what Managed/BYOC actually includes, and independent corroboration.
